unresolved: C17 mode selection is internally shadowed: `elseif (NPFORT >= 1)` at L911 consumes NPFORT=2, so the five-field PFX2 read at L927-L936 is unreachable; the same ordering at L947 and L956 makes the mode-2 PFX2 broadcast unreachable. North boundary repeats the shadow at L1258 versus L1279. Consequently mode-2 interpolation later reads PFX2 at L1018/L1109/L1198/L1288 without this file's intended population path.

South NPFORT=1 amplitude calculation uses `PCBS(L,M)` in the cosine term at L1000 while the block writes and otherwise reads `PCBS_GL`/`PSBS_GL` at L998-L1005; `PCBS` is not populated in that global-boundary block.
Diagnostic output L507-L508 labels both global widths as x-direction although L508 writes `global_max_width_y`.

Jet/WQ input raises MMAX by NWQV at L1529-L1531, fills CQCJP/CWRCJP through MMAX at L1541-L1545, then reuses the completed DO variable MS and increments it for active kinetics at L1548-L1553. The final index can exceed the just-read MMAX range; array bounds and downstream compact-layout intent are defined outside this file.

Cohesive card C39 reads `ISEDSCOR(NS)` at L2000, but cohesive broadcasts L2010-L2018 omit it. C40 reads `SEDS(NS).WCLIMIT` at L2025, also omitted there. Both are broadcast only inside the later NSND>0 block (L2089-L2092), so cohesive-only MPI runs have unsynchronized non-master values. The master-only TAUCRCOH file read L2031-L2037 likewise has no broadcast visible here.
`DYESTEPW` is read on master at L2710 but no broadcast follows before the dye-options block ends at L2716.
`CLTMSR_GL` is read with C87 station metadata L3258-L3263, but its only broadcast is commented out at L3278.

MODDXDY derives local I/J from global ITMP/JTMP at L3634-L3635 and validates local bounds, but then calls `LIJ(ITMP,JTMP)` at L3639 rather than `LIJ(I,J)`; FBODY demonstrates the consistent local-index form at L3903-L3910.

MODCHAN initializes MDCHH=0 on every rank L3657, master reads MDCHH/QCHERR/channel and LMD/QCHAN data L3659-L3706, but broadcasts only selected raw arrays L3710-L3718. MDCHH, QCHERR, LMDCH*, and QCHAN* are not synchronized in this file.

`AVO=ABS(AVO)` at L3799 precedes `if(AVO<0.)` at L3805, making AVMAP mode unreachable. Within that branch L3837-L3840 assigns AHMAX/AHMIN/ADMAX/ADMIN from fixed AVMAX/AVMIN/ABMAX/ABMIN rather than updating the AV/AB extrema and prints inside the LG loop L3843.
PARTITIONB's spatially constant else branch L4147-L4153 writes `TOXPARW` instead of `TOXPARB`, leaving the bed array unexpanded while overwriting the water-column array.

POCB executes `STPOCB(L,K)=0.0` at L4414 before this block establishes L/K loops, and several IREAD formats L4416-L4456/L4484-L4507 read unit 1 on every rank although only master opened it L4402-L4406. L4460 clears `STDOCB` in the POCB branch. FPOCB IREAD=2 alternative format uses NS as implied-do stride at L4576. FOCB closes unit 1 on master at L4653 and closes it again on all ranks at L4670.
DYE sequential format loops `do L=LG,LA_Global` at L4850 but stores every record into `DYE_Global(LG,...)` at L4851; LG is not assigned in that branch and the loop variable L is unused.
TOXB missing-layer fill L5153-L5156 is outside the global-cell loop, so it fills only the final LG's layers KBINPUT+1:KB rather than every cell.
PSERAVG normalization L5695-L5696 divides by TIM(NREC)-TIM(1) without checking NREC>=2 or nonzero endpoint separation.

SSER reads record count into `MCSER(NS,1)` at L5869 but loops on `TSSAL(NS).NREC` at L5874/L5883; no assignment connects those fields in this file. ASER repeats this at L6757 versus L6766/L6774, WSER at L6903 versus L6907/L6909, and ISER/ISTAT at L7012/L7046 versus L7015/L7049.

TXDRY converts class 1 from per-day to per-second at L6299 but omits `/86400` for classes 2..NTOX at L6301-L6305. TXDRY/TXWET are also opened and read by all ranks without master/broadcast wrapping at L6282-L6341, unlike adjacent series.

QCTRULES sorts IDX by descending RULES level at L6556-L6565 but ON and OFF trigger construction uses RULES(M,...) directly at L6570-L6607, never RULES(IDX(M),...), so the sort does not affect stored trigger order.
ISICE=1 series are read only on master L7001-L7035, while MITLAST/TSICE broadcasts L7057-L7065 are inside the `elseif(ISICE==2)` branch; no ISICE=1 broadcast is visible.

MHK nesting pairs `elseif(NFLAGPWR==2/3)` L7310/L7313 with `if(process_id==master_id)` L7262, not with the already-ended inner flag-1 test L7264-L7286. Flag-1 collective broadcasts L7288-L7308 therefore execute only on master; flag-3 is entered only by non-master ranks and its nested master read L7314 cannot execute. Flag-3 also reads one stale-M element at L7315 without a class loop. The final cell check L7364-L7370 uses scalar DIAMMHK last computed only in master paths.

PARSE_LOGICAL can return an unassigned logical when a colon is followed only by blanks (L7564-L7568). PARSESTRING has no fallback when neither blank nor tab exists before masked MINVAL/slicing L7590-L7594. READ_SUBSET does not broadcast HFREGRP names assigned L7655-L7657; HFREDAYEN/HFREDAY are allocated L7619-L7620 but never assigned/broadcast; its ISO check L7654 is stale with respect to internal substring reads L7644-L7652.

content.what_it_is: `SUBROUTINE INPUT` at L9 is the EFDC+ configuration and initial-state loader. It reads the main `efdc.inp` cards C1-C91C on the master rank, broadcasts card values, derives grid/time/forcing coefficients, reads CELL/CELLLT/DXDY and many optional maps and constituent files, maps global arrays to local MPI domains, reads boundary/source/control/atmospheric/wind/ice/vegetation/MHK time series, and invokes final field/cyclone loaders (L133-L7515). The same source then defines PARSE_REAL, PARSE_LOGICAL, PARSESTRING, and READ_SUBSET (L7521-L7679). Main-card groups are: title/modes/restart/time/grid/turbulence/forcing C1-C15 (L133-L868); pressure and four-side tidal boundaries C16-C21 (L870-L1323); constituents/sources/jets/structures/withdrawal/sediment/toxics C22-C45E (L1325-L2478); buoyancy/thermal/ice/dye and four-side concentration boundaries C46-C66 (L2480-L3064); output controls C67-C91C (L3072-L3360). Auxiliary input families and their algorithms are enumerated in io and equations below.
